source: Spatial master matrix v2.2 and audited threat-rule catalogue

rows.threshold: Minimum temperature during emergence < 6 °C for 2 hours per episode; 2, 4 and 6 hours were compared
rows.qualitative_impact: Delayed and uneven emergence with reduced dry-matter accumulation.
rows.quantitative_impact: Temperatures below 6 °C significantly reduced emergence; at ≤2 °C, final emergence was below 50% in unfavorable moisture combinations.

details.spatial_scope: Study-specific experimental setting; see the cited source
details.limitations: Response depends strongly on soil moisture and exposure duration.

rows.threshold: Soil water potential <= -0.51 MPa for 4 days after irrigation was withheld in 15-day-old plants
rows.qualitative_impact: Leaf elongation was inhibited; root growth was inhibited later under more severe drying.

details.spatial_scope: Study-specific experimental setting; see the cited source
details.limitations: The threshold represents leaf-growth inhibition, not a direct yield-loss threshold.
